comment:
* Represents a server transaction. Implements the following state machines. * * 
 *
 *
 *
 *                                                                      |INVITE
 *                                                                      |pass INV to TU
 *                                                   INVITE             V send 100 if TU won't in 200ms
 *                                                   send response+-----------+
 *                                                       +--------|           |--------+101-199 from TU
 *                                                       |        | Proceeding|        |send response
 *                                                       +------->|           |<-------+
 *                                                                |           |          Transport Err.
 *                                                                |           |          Inform TU
 *                                                                |           |--------------->+
 *                                                                +-----------+                |
 *                                                   300-699 from TU |     |2xx from TU        |
 *                                                   send response   |     |send response      |
 *                                                                   |     +------------------>+
 *                                                                   |                         |
 *                                                   INVITE          V          Timer G fires  |
 *                                                   send response+-----------+ send response  |
 *                                                       +--------|           |--------+       |
 *                                                       |        | Completed |        |       |
 *                                                       +------->|           |<-------+       |
 *                                                                +-----------+                |
 *                                                                   |     |                   |
 *                                                               ACK |     |                   |
 *                                                               -   |     +------------------>+
 *                                                                   |        Timer H fires    |
 *                                                                   V        or Transport Err.|
 *                                                                +-----------+  Inform TU     |
 *                                                                |           |                |
 *                                                                | Confirmed |                |
 *                                                                |           |                |
 *                                                                +-----------+                |
 *                                                                      |                      |
 *                                                                      |Timer I fires         |
 *                                                                      |-                     |
 *                                                                      |                      |
 *                                                                      V                      |
 *                                                                +-----------+                |
 *                                                                |           |                |
 *                                                                | Terminated|<---------------+
 *                                                                |           |
 *                                                                +-----------+
 *
 *                                                     Figure 7: INVITE server transaction
 *                                                         Request received
 *                                                                         |pass to TU
 *
 *                                                                         V
 *                                                                   +-----------+
 *                                                                   |           |
 *                                                                   | Trying    |-------------+
 *                                                                   |           |             |
 *                                                                   +-----------+             |200-699 from TU
 *                                                                         |                   |send response
 *                                                                         |1xx from TU        |
 *                                                                         |send response      |
 *                                                                         |                   |
 *                                                      Request            V      1xx from TU  |
 *                                                      send response+-----------+send response|
 *                                                          +--------|           |--------+    |
 *                                                          |        | Proceeding|        |    |
 *                                                          +------->|           |<-------+    |
 *                                                   +<--------------|           |             |
 *                                                   |Trnsprt Err    +-----------+             |
 *                                                   |Inform TU            |                   |
 *                                                   |                     |                   |
 *                                                   |                     |200-699 from TU    |
 *                                                   |                     |send response      |
 *                                                   |  Request            V                   |
 *                                                   |  send response+-----------+             |
 *                                                   |      +--------|           |             |
 *                                                   |      |        | Completed |<------------+
 *                                                   |      +------->|           |
 *                                                   +<--------------|           |
 *                                                   |Trnsprt Err    +-----------+
 *                                                   |Inform TU            |
 *                                                   |                     |Timer J fires
 *                                                   |                     |-
 *                                                   |                     |
 *                                                   |                     V
 *                                                   |               +-----------+
 *                                                   |               |           |
 *                                                   +-------------->| Terminated|
 *                                                                   |           |
 *                                                                   +-----------+
 *
 *
 *
 *
 *
 *
* * @version 1.2 $Revision: 1.118 $ $Date: 2010/01/10 00:13:14 $ * @author M. Ranganathan *
